summary: Junior **Python Backend Developer** focused on building secure and maintainable backend services using **FastAPI**. Experienced in developing REST APIs, database-driven applications, and applying software engineering principles to build reliable systems.

experience.title: Junior Backend Developer
experience.description: Order-management team of 6 engineers; services handle about **40k requests per minute**.
highlights: Reduced p95 latency of the vendor menu endpoint from **480 ms to 190 ms** by adding composite PostgreSQL indexes and replacing N+1 SQLAlchemy queries with joined loads.
Eliminated **95% of malformed-payload errors** reaching the database layer by adding Pydantic validation and uniform error responses to 14 endpoints.
Shortened release time from **40 to 12 minutes** by automating tests and Docker image builds in a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

experience.title: Backend Developer Intern
highlights: Built 8 REST endpoints with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for the internal campaign dashboard, used daily by **30 ad-operations staff**.
Cut weekly campaign-report preparation from **2 hours to 5 minutes** by replacing a manual spreadsheet export with a scheduled SQL aggregation job.

experience.title: Freelance Backend Developer
highlights: Delivered an appointment-booking API for a dental clinic in **6 weeks**, replacing phone scheduling for about **200 monthly appointments**.
Deployed the service with **Docker** on a Linux server and handled schema changes with **Alembic** migrations.

projects.title: Zero Drop
projects.description: Open-source paste service where text is encrypted in the browser before upload.
highlights: Encrypted pastes in the browser with **AES-256-GCM**, so plaintext and decryption keys never appear in server requests.
Added password-based encryption with **PBKDF2** key derivation.
Hardened the API with **rate limiting** and security headers.

projects.title: Secure Lens
projects.description: Command-line scanner that audits project security configuration and ranks findings by risk.
highlights: Built modular static checks that detect **exposed secrets**, insecure environment settings, Dockerfile risks, and Git configuration issues.
Integrated the **Jev decision model** to assess exploitability and adjust finding severity beyond rule-based detection.
